description: Implement AJAX endpoint for pagination and frontend JavaScript for Load More button and auto-load infinite scroll. AJAX route GET /ajax/smart-products returns JSON with {success, data: {html, hasMore, currentPage, totalShown}}. JavaScript handles button click, fetches next page, appends HTML to grid, updates data attributes, hides button when no more products. IntersectionObserver for auto-load watches a sentinel element, triggers fetch when visible. Error handling shows user-friendly message in console and UI.
steps: Add AJAX route after existing /ajax/recently-viewed-products route (around line 340): Route::get('ajax/smart-products', ['uses' => 'PublicProductController@ajaxGetSmartProducts', 'as' => 'public.ajax.smart-products'])
Add method ajaxGetSmartProducts(Request $request, SmartProductService $smartProductService) at end of class
Calculate offset: $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage, $limit = $perPage + 1 (fetch one extra to detect hasMore)

Fetch products via service: switch($criteria) { case 'most_viewed': $products = $smartProductService->getMostViewed($offset + $limit, $categoryId); break; ... } then $products = $products->slice($offset, $limit)
In JS: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const grids = document.querySelectorAll('.js-smart-products-grid'); grids.forEach(initSmartProductsGrid); })

Function initSmartProductsGrid(grid) { const loadMoreBtn = grid.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('.js-load-more-smart-products'); const loadingEl = grid.parentElement.parentElement.querySelector('.js-load-more-loading'); const loadMoreType = grid.dataset.loadMoreType; if(loadMoreType === 'button' && loadMoreBtn) { loadMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => loadMoreProducts(grid, loadMoreBtn, loadingEl)); } else if(loadMoreType === 'auto') { setupInfiniteScroll(grid, loadingEl); } }

Function loadMoreProducts(grid, btn, loadingEl) { const criteria = grid.dataset.criteria; const categoryId = grid.dataset.categoryId || ''; const perPage = parseInt(grid.dataset.itemsPerPage); const currentPage = parseInt(grid.dataset.currentPage); const nextPage = currentPage + 1; btn.style.display = 'none'; loadingEl.style.display = 'block'; const url = `/ajax/smart-products?criteria=${criteria}&category_id=${categoryId}&page=${nextPage}&per_page=${perPage}`; fetch(url).then(res => { if(!res.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok'); return res.json(); }).then(data => { if(data.success && data.data.html) { grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', data.data.html); grid.dataset.currentPage = data.data.currentPage; grid.dataset.totalShown = data.data.totalShown; if(data.data.hasMore) { btn.style.display = 'block'; } loadingEl.style.display = 'none'; } else { throw new Error('Invalid response'); } }).catch(err => { console.error('Error loading products:', err); loadingEl.innerHTML = '

Failed to load products. Please try again.

'; setTimeout(() => { loadingEl.style.display = 'none'; btn.style.display = 'block'; }, 3000); }); }

Function setupInfiniteScroll(grid, loadingEl) { const sentinel = document.createElement('div'); sentinel.className = 'js-smart-products-sentinel'; sentinel.style.height = '1px'; grid.parentElement.appendChild(sentinel); const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach(entry => { if(entry.isIntersecting && !grid.dataset.loading) { grid.dataset.loading = 'true'; loadingEl.style.display = 'block'; const criteria = grid.dataset.criteria; const categoryId = grid.dataset.categoryId || ''; const perPage = parseInt(grid.dataset.itemsPerPage); const currentPage = parseInt(grid.dataset.currentPage); const nextPage = currentPage + 1; fetch(`/ajax/smart-products?criteria=${criteria}&category_id=${categoryId}&page=${nextPage}&per_page=${perPage}`).then(res => res.json()).then(data => { if(data.success && data.data.html) { grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', data.data.html); grid.dataset.currentPage = data.data.currentPage; grid.dataset.totalShown = data.data.totalShown; if(!data.data.hasMore) { observer.disconnect(); sentinel.remove(); } } loadingEl.style.display = 'none'; delete grid.dataset.loading; }).catch(err => { console.error('Error loading products:', err); loadingEl.innerHTML = '

Failed to load products.

'; setTimeout(() => { loadingEl.style.display = 'none'; delete grid.dataset.loading; }, 3000); }); } }); }, { rootMargin: '100px' }); observer.observe(sentinel); }
Register JS file: open platform/themes/martfury/config.php, find 'javascript' array, add 'js/smart-products.js' to the list (creates array entry so file is included globally)
Alternative if config.php doesn't have global JS array: add <script src="{{ Theme::asset()->url('js/smart-products.js') }}"></script> at bottom of smart-products.blade.php template
acceptance_criteria: AJAX route /ajax/smart-products exists and returns JSON
AJAX endpoint validates criteria parameter against whitelist
AJAX returns {success: true, data: {html, hasMore, currentPage, totalShown}}
HTML returned contains product-card-enhanced markup for each product
hasMore is true when more products exist, false when exhausted
Frontend JS file smart-products.js is loaded on pages with smart-products shortcode
Load More button click fetches next page via AJAX and appends products to grid
IntersectionObserver triggers fetch when sentinel becomes visible (auto-load mode)
Error handling displays user-friendly message and allows retry
Grid data attributes update after each successful fetch (currentPage, totalShown)
verification: Visit page with [smart-products] shortcode, open browser DevTools Network tab
Click Load More button - verify GET /ajax/smart-products request fires
Verify response is JSON with success:true, data.html contains <div class="ec-card">
Verify products append to grid (count increases from 6 to 12)
Click Load More again until exhausted - verify button disappears when no more products
Test auto-load mode: insert shortcode with load_more_type="auto", scroll down - products load automatically as sentinel enters viewport
Test error handling: block /ajax/smart-products in DevTools, click Load More - verify error message appears
Test category filter: insert shortcode with category_id="5", verify AJAX requests include category_id=5 and only products from that category load
